description.value: A private campground with a wide sandy beach directly on Shuswap Lake near Salmon Arm, offering mountain views, a swim dock, playground, hot showers, and a convenience store; open seasonally to September 15th with a firm deposit-and-cancellation policy.

address.value: 2100 Sandy Point Rd, Salmon Arm, BC V1E 2Z8

raw_osm.name: Sandy Point
raw_osm.source: Personal - I have a season lot at this campsite.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at sandyptcampground.ca is fully accessible and provides rich amenity detail. The amenities page explicitly confirms hot showers, a covered cook house, and an on-site convenience store, and explicitly denies Wi-Fi. The booking system confirms reservations are accepted. OSM contributed only the camp_site tag and coordinates; address and phone come entirely from the website since OSM carried neither.
concerns: OSM name is 'Sandy Point' but website name is 'Sandy Point Campground' — minor discrepancy.
OSM record includes 'natural=cliff' tag, which appears misapplied or erroneous for a campground.
OSM carried no phone or address; both are sourced entirely from the website.
OSM source note indicates data was submitted by a private season-lot holder rather than the business operator.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active lakeside campground with confirmed hot showers, covered cook house, and on-site convenience store — a solid amenity set for touring cyclists on the Shuswap Lake corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: Amenities page explicitly states: 'There is no Wi-Fi or Internet access provided at the Campground.'
